overall.verdict: A visually coherent, trust-forward wallet with a genuinely differentiated green-vs-violet enforceability story, but it talks to experts in jargon on exactly the screens newcomers need, and several right-column cards visibly overflow or float over dead space. Consistency is high; information scent for non-crypto users and completion of secondary screens (Ownership, Lending) is where it falls short of shipping quality.
priority_fixes: Fix all right-edge overflow/clipping (05 book, 15 per-counterparty, 16 table/book, 09 scale demo) — broken layout reads as broken product
Rewrite jargon on Receive, Assets, Lending and Ownership into plain language with tooltips (capacity, allowance, lazy entity, basis points)
Replace duplicated text panels (How to read this, WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS, Move's from/to cards) with compact visual components to recover space and reduce cognitive load
Make trust claims interactive: proof hash copy, frame viewer links, evidence bundle preview
Fill or restructure the pervasive empty right/lower space (04, 10, 11, 16) with actionable content: invoices, disputes, open orders
